visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shots of a Thai-style pork salad being mixed in a bowl with yellow tongs. The salad contains thinly sliced pork, onions, cucumber, and red chili. A hand garnish with fresh cilantro is seen. (2) A person's hand adds salt to boiling water in a black speckled pot. Thinly sliced pink raw pork is then added using tongs and stirred as it cooks and turns white. (3) The cooked pork is moved into a bowl of cold water to cool. Next, the hand slices an onion and a cucumber into thin strips on a wooden board, which are then placed into a bowl of ice water. (4) A male chef in a white uniform stands in a studio kitchen with a green background. He pours several liquid ingredients like fish sauce and lemon juice into a glass bowl, then adds minced garlic and chili flakes, stirring with a spoon. (5) The cooled pork and vegetables are added to the dressing. The chef uses tongs to thoroughly mix all components. The finished dish is shown in a close-up, piled high and topped with fresh green cilantro.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, medium-tempo electronic pop BGM starts immediately with a clear kick drum beat. A male narrator introduces the dish with high energy. Wet squishing and sliding sounds accompany the visual mixing of salad. (2) The sound of water boiling softly in a pot is heard. A metallic clink occurs as salt is tossed in, followed by the soft rustling sound of tongs handling meat. The narrator explains the cooking temperature. (3) A distinct splash sound as meat enters cold water. This is followed by rapid, rhythmic wooden tapping sounds as a knife slices vegetables on a board. (4) The clinking of glass bowls and metal spoons occurs as the narrator lists ingredients. The sound of liquid pouring is crisp and clear. (5) Mixing sounds return as the ingredients are combined. A subtle digital whoosh SFX marks a transition. The narrator concludes with an enthusiastic invitation to try the dish as the BGM volume swells slightly before cutting off.
